# 99designs

> 99designs is a global creative platform connecting businesses with professional designers for custom graphic design, logos, websites, and branding through contests and one-on-one collaboration.

99designs operates a two-sided marketplace where clients can browse design categories, launch contests, or hire from a curated network of freelance designers. The platform showcases designer portfolios and offers specialized services like logo design, web design, and brand identity work.

## Core Platform

- [99designs Home](https://99designs.com): 99designs global creative platform for custom graphic design, logos, websites and contests
- [How it Works](https://99designs.com/how-it-works): Guide to launching design contests and working with designers on 99designs platform
- [Design Categories](https://99designs.com/categories): Browse all graphic design service categories including logos, web, packaging and more
- [Design Inspiration Gallery](https://99designs.com/discover): Gallery showcasing top designs and creative inspiration from global design community

## Design Services

- [Logo Design Services](https://99designs.com/logo-design): Professional custom logo design service with award-winning designers and contests
- [Logo Design Details & Pricing](https://99designs.com/logo-design/details): Detailed information on logo design packages, pricing and delivery specifications
- [Circlemakers Studio](https://99designs.com/pro/studio): 99designs partner agency offering full-service branding, strategy and visual identity
